Card Q&A.q: My Digimon's effect gave me  and trashed 1 card in my hand. The number of cards in my hand was the same before and after the effect activated, so does this card's inherited effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon's effects adds cards to your hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
